title: Product
description: JSON Schema for a product — the universal cone over a discrete diagram (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. III §5; Awodey 2010 §5.1). A product of objects A_1, ..., A_n consists of an object P together with projection morphisms π_i : P → A_i such that any other object Q with morphisms q_i : Q → A_i factors uniquely through P. Uses oneOf to distinguish the binary case (two factors) from the n-ary case (any number of factors), pinning the factor count via a count discriminator in each branch.

factors.description: The objects A_1, ..., A_n being multiplied. At least two; uniqueItems enforces distinct factors.

projections.description: The projection morphisms π_i : P → A_i, one per factor in the same order. Length matches factors.

product-object.description: The product object P = A_1 × ... × A_n.
